## Scope / 対象

## What Needs Review / 確認したいこと

- [ ] Japanese-first UI copy
- [ ] Human-facing instructions match visible labels
- [ ] Responsive viewport checks around 390px, 768px, and 1280px or wider
- [ ] Empty, loading, error, focus, hover, and disabled states
- [ ] Console and network findings when tooling supports it
- [ ] Honest `未確認` reporting for anything not actually checked

## Evidence / 根拠

- Commands run:
- Viewport sizes checked:
- Browser or screenshot tooling used:
- Remaining unknowns:

## Safety Check / 安全確認

- [ ] This issue does not include secrets, tokens, OAuth credentials, auth cookies, customer data, private repository URLs, local absolute paths, or real operational logs.
